exceptions.reason: SQLAlchemy 2.1 now types the joined presence rows, which exposes that the stored installation, run, route and rank states are plain string columns while the strict Pydantic presence views declare their literal state sets. The view model validates each literal at construction, so an unknown stored state is still refused at runtime; typing the columns as literals would need a SQLAlchemy type map for every state enum.

The case deliberately constructs AgentSource with a raw mapping where AgentIdentity is declared, to prove the frozen dataclass refuses an untyped identity at runtime. The mismatch is the assertion, so it cannot be annotated away without deleting the case.
